title: JigWireEnvelope
description: Header fields every v0.1 wire frame carries. Frame-specific fields sit alongside them, selected by `op`. See src/versioning.md.

v.description: Envelope version. Any other value is refused with UNSUPPORTED_VERSION.

suite.description: Encryption suite of the frame's payload (src/encryption.md). Absent means `none`. v0.1 implementations refuse `mls` and anything unregistered with UNSUPPORTED_SUITE.
